Bug_Explanation: The bug 'LockOnBoxedPrimitive' is demonstrated by synchronizing on a boxed Integer. This can lead to unintentionally sharing a lock with another piece of code due to caching of instances of boxed primitive types.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered by synchronizing on a boxed Integer in two separate threads. Due to caching of instances of boxed primitive types, both threads might be synchronized on the same lock, causing unexpected behavior and a test failure.
